'FReview.BoundaryRemainder.actual_retained_omitted_balance' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
FReview.BoundaryRemainder.actual_retained_omitted_balance (a l r s : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℂ)
  (rho : FReview.BoundaryRemainder.GenuineZero) :
  ↑(FReview.BoundaryRemainder.retained a l r s rho) * FReview.BoundaryRemainder.radialMellin a h rho +
      ↑(FReview.BoundaryRemainder.zeroOrder rho - FReview.BoundaryRemainder.retained a l r s rho) *
        FReview.BoundaryRemainder.radialMellin a h rho =
    ↑(FReview.BoundaryRemainder.zeroOrder rho) * FReview.BoundaryRemainder.radialMellin a h rho
